notes.title: Patch v1.0.8-1
notes.content:
🌟 Improvements


 Higher quality items of the same type can now be used as substitutions for lower quality item requirements. This change effects both crafting and shipping. Preference is set to take the lowest quality items first, e.g. if you need a heartberry but only have +1 and +2 variety, your +1 will be used first.
 The improved filter menu for silos has now been added for Belt Feeders.
 Importers set to infinity mode now respect local silo limits.
 Razorgrass is now discoverable on the starting planet so you don't have to purchase it from the importer before getting to Praetoria.

🌟 Improvements

 A sticky indicator has been added for when item pickup is disabled to let players know that items pickup is off and what key to press and hold to flip it back on


🐛 Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue on gamepad where various menus would automatically dismiss if the continue button was being pressed or held while they opened
 Fixed a crashing issue when using Ophelia's drill and targeting a new resource
 Fixed an issue where domesticated mushroom deer would target invalid crops
 Fixed an issue where both quick stack and weapon toggle are bound to the same button on gamepad resulting in both actions toggling at the same time


🚨 IMPORTANT steam deck players 🚨

If you are playing on Steam Deck I have been getting reports that the game often crashes on start up. To fix this make sure to update your compatibility settings to force the use of Proton 9.0-4 since Experimental is currently not working with this game.

If you're not sure how to do that, follow these steps:
[olist]
 Open the game's library page that has the big play button on the left.
 On the right side look for a gear icon. Press it and in the resulting menu select Properties.
 Now select Compatibility from the left side menu.
 Check the box to Force the use of a specific Steam compatibility tool
 From the dropdown, select Proton 9.0-4
 If it doesn't work still, restart your Steam Deck and check this setting again to see if it flipped to Proton Hotfix. Set it to 9.0-4 again.
[/olist]

notes.title: Prospector: What’s Next on the Horizon?
notes.content:
Hello, Prospectors!
Time really flies and I'm steadily moving closer to the full release of Prospector. I’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and there’s a lot of exciting new content in my pipeline to enhance your space adventures!

Let me share a little sneak peek of the confirmed features you can look forward to in the full version of Prospector:

Interplanetary Travel
Get ready to explore a new cozy biome filled with unique resources to take your production to the next level! You’ll also gain access to a Space Elevator as part of a new questline that will unlock the ability to import resources from other planets!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/8e5dcd2274cb506297b20bae33b36e5c3c161873.gif

Expanded Progression System
Grow your production with additional shipping ranks and new structures. I'm working on a new power source called a Geothermal Powerplant as well as new resource capturing structures like a gas collector and oil pumps which will also come with new recipes and shippable resources. 

More Varied Alien Flora and Fauna
The world of Prospector is about to get livelier! I’m working on introducing new alien species to make the environments feel more alive and dynamic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/3d25ffef65c5d3983b61b63f785f7e0624ee82b2.gif

New Colony Contracts
Your neighboring colonists are eager to collaborate with you even more. Expect an expanded range of contracts with fresh requests to complete, each with a novel prospecting experience.


These are just a few of the features I’m excited to bring to Prospector. There’s much more in store as I approach the finish line, and I’m thrilled to have you along for the journey. Stay tuned for updates, and as always, thank you for your support, feedback, and passion for the game.

Happy Prospecting!

notes.title: How to drill with your robot
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/140b894ffaec9e34287a71b46fc4375f597b89dd.jpg

Acquire O.P.H.E.L.I.A.’s new drill mod then start slamming the ground in search of hidden resources.

Each strike sends out a scan that will look for subterranean deposits. Follow the green scan line to the source and strike the ground again to unearth a brand new mineral deposit which can be mined with O.P.H.E.L.I.A.!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/fd6e521ae8e9054e8af8dff72ada7e7cc3d5b649.jpg

Or slap an Exporter on it for automated mineral collection!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/e1048db321fbbd23ac694937dec144986c0000bb.jpg

And much more… 🚀

My focus for the v3 Beta was to improve the overall feel of the game. I made a ton of smaller changes including UI overhauls, game feel adjustments, and brand new particle effects.

Structure effects to make things juicer 🔥

All the game’s crafting stations have working effects like steam, smoke, and sparks to make crafting feel more lively and tactile.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/1e2382627ffc9be2d1377a5157fae7cd885a4386.jpg

Peaceful weather for immersion but also a new danger ☔

Enjoy some light rain, wind, and blowing leaves, but beware of solar storms!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/e531d8528b7ec0138ba1db3c8a36a8889639bdaa.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/79b4d0572fbc7b7ac9d8a544d1e76e20f0e5b82e.jpg

Change your look 👓

Customize your character’s appearance with the new Changing Station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/5afd6889a66328cfac88d386c7a9ec99f7c23065.jpg

Improving bot behaviors 🤖

I’ve introduced a new way to  think about logistics by linking logistics bots directly to a single Crafting Station or Exporter. This means logistics bots will only collect resources for that specific structure and effectively automate its production. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/a5f7ccf1e357ce2579333ee1f3258ea8b452dc1e.jpg

Quality of life ✌

I’ve added a new Orders Widget to the game’s HUD allowing a quick glance at what orders you have and what materials you still need to ship. I also added key rebinding and a variety of other new settings options so you can customize your experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/1f08a9edc6391dc8d45e7edd234845381ed489f6.jpg

Did you want to check it out? 👀

You can sign up for the Beta by joining my Newsletter at Loonworks Games
And then join the Discord to chat about your experience. I’d love to hear what you think!

notes.title: How to create a resin farm with giant moths
notes.content:
Start by finding a heavily forested area

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/cfa63104b8a845339226302ba8f2891337502acb.png

Trees are a critical part of resin production. The colony cannot  grow without them, so make sure there are a handful of trees nearby before placing your incubator.

Wait for the queen to lay eggs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/c87734202c2c27cd38884a53e5cc73d9350e68db.png

Once the incubator is powered, the queen will automatically start pumping out fresh cocoons, each containing a single moth larvae.

Let moths harvest resin for you... or use a laser

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/ef7d71e81cd47e3703d4ebd53bad4205726a4a93.png

Moths will infest nearby trees by injecting their saliva into the cambium, causing trees to produce massive amounts of resin. The moths will then harvest and carry resin back to their queen, stored safely inside the incubator, allowing the player to collect the resin later. However resin can also be harvested directly with a laser for a quicker haul.

Plant more trees to increase production!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/4a6a1c3c86831a877cc472dc4bb3cf01b798940a.png

Moths will only infest trees within a certain radius of their queen. That means once all the original trees are infested, you'll need to plant more. The infestation effectively destroys the original tree, so planting seeds is the only way to keep the farm running!

notes.title: Post Festival Feedback and Improvements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/edc34c251f199a4f32e5f3691684fa1f3a4c4b90.jpg

Earlier this month I participated with 24 other amazing indie developers in the Seattle Indies Expo! Here are some of the biggest issues people ran into playing the game and how I addressed them:

1. I need more inventory space!
Always a tricky one for games of this genre. Limiting space is a deliberate choice on my part but it wasn't fun watching people destroy items to make room in their pack. So I reduced the cost to repair your companion robot O.P.H.E.L.I.A so that she can be accessed really early on, effectively doubling your pack space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/0b0ff9f86dc680621867a7aeb2727a3288792f54.png

2. No parody between left analog and D-pad is annoying!
For gamepad players, there was a lot of frustration with the default controls and people expected to be able to use both the analog stick and the D-pad when navigating menus. So I made that a thing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/3a37269ee7c41a051a53ea8b71d14a84122d0e43.png

3. Holding down a key for longer periods of time is fatiguing!
The Prospector's jetpack is a toggle action by default but I was really surprised to hear people asking for that to be a hold action and for the laser to be a toggle. I had some QA folks play as well and for accessibility reasons, their feedback was to make any hold action that happens a lot a toggle. So I decided to support both actions and added an option in settings so you can decide how you want to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/d695e228976c2a85501cda4049ff0712ea0f1e21.png

4. I've never played this kind of game before and I need more help!
It's always interesting to see people who've never played a base builder / crafting game give Prospector a spin! While my goal is not to optimize for these kinds of players, there were some game concepts that I felt could be explained better. So I added a hint system that can also be turned off in settings that will pop up some key information about the game as you move through the early stages of building an outpost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/4161493d072552b2c8fdd53417e59a4332ff3bdb.png

5. Having to slam an interaction key on Mouse and Keyboard is no fun!
I saw players taking their hands off the mouse to collect their crops with the keyboard and that's definitely not a great solution. So instead of using the keyboard to interact with things, the primary action is now a mouse click. I think it feels a whole lot better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/681f2baf2c7477c88d283748dd595ad02f92370d.png

6. I want to quickly make one more of the thing I just crafted!
For folks who wanted to do a lot of exploring, it was annoying to go in and out of the crafting menu to make supply lines. I saw folks get hung up on this with power routers as well. So I added a "quick craft" action that remembers the last thing you crafted and allows you to quickly make one more without going back into the menu screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/a26f8aa3d1294048fdc19b1e24b925fa51d1b878.png

There were a bunch of other small changes I added to this latest release that for now, is only available in the Beta but will soon be available in the Demo as well.

A big "thank you" to everyone who played!

notes.title: How to survive then thrive with the new Cropping feature
notes.content:
How does the Cropping feature work?

Harvested seeds can be planted wherever you like as long as they have space to grow.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/438c8173c9f21c009452867f5e1322e4954c2739.png

Continue to increase your shipping level to unlock Terraformers and Composters. These structures can be used to generate fertilizer for increased crop quality, and rich soil tiles that speed up the growth and fruiting of plants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/78aea2eab451e7249b1f3af05fa49c56ce88f399.png

A new Progression System and Shipping logic
This update takes the game's existing content but provides a more engaging leveling experience where structural blueprints are rewards for increasing your shipping rank. As the game is updated and new structures are added, these rewards will increase, providing more content and unique experiences so you always know what you're working towards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/63b4dc858de676ac99eb18e07d00716508598167.png

An Improved game interface makes item selection easier and more intuitive
The old Quick Slot system which limited players to 4 items has been totally redone as an infinite toolbar. Items from your inventory will be displayed in your toolbar automatically as they are collected, so there's no need to assign anything, and you can get back to enjoying the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/bb2657d493e0082f362d781445eaa53f755760d1.png

The new "Sweet Spot" mechanic
After collecting 100+ resources, the laser tool can start to feel a little dull. To spice things up, certain resources will have a "sweet spot" and if you maintain contact with your laser for a period of time, you'll be rewarded with a burst of extra resources. Laser smarter, not harder!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/f11632b8746bdb48555bbf7a3f2b282edebea99a.png

How can I get more involved?

Are you interested in providing input on the Prospecting experience? Join the Loonworks Games Discord and let me know what you'd to see in future updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/4666dbfaa34870ee09374175e66324ea52be2079.png

notes.title: How to use jetpacks like a pro
notes.content:
How does the jetpack work?

The jetpack is a speed upgrade that uses power from your suit, so be mindful of your energy levels! No power means no jetpack and no laser to harvest resources or protect against enemies. Position your supply lines strategically to create your own mini highways!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/209258698afb67615c4a2236b6fe6a731215d5d9.jpg

The jetpack as of this update is a Beta only feature and can be acquired by printing from the new Fabricator structure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/91bcbe32e2362bdf07324d6d9fd3a27209d75bd4.jpg

Are you interested in providing input on other Fabricator schematics or the Prospecting experience in general? Join the Loonworks Games Discord and let me know what you'd to see in future updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42111003/4666dbfaa34870ee09374175e66324ea52be2079.png
